summary: Sydney designer womenswear label with an in-house finance team led by CFO Jenny Huang and an accountant (Cathy Zhang) who owns Shopify/AP21 sales and returns reconciliation. However, on 3 Nov 2026 the founder announced the brand is closing after 26 years, so this is not a viable prospect and no outreach drafts were written.
